description: Phase 5 golden set v1 — 15 cases (9 en / 6 zh) across all six feature facets. expected.hard is a MUST-CONTAIN subset of the parsed hard constraints (the deterministic extractor + provider union may add more values); equal parsers must never omit these. ok is the expected final verdict.

cases.query: a relaxed outfit for a coffee date with a top and trousers
cases.note: Category keywords 'top' + 'trousers' force a full top+bottom look; coffee date is context (never a filter).

Bilingual extraction: 蓝色/黑色 → palette, 短袖→tops, 裤子→bottoms. The IDEAL look is t1 (blue tee) + b2 (black jeans); the offline hash embedding empirically prefers the all-black t5+b4 combo (shorter texts, denser overlap). Constraint-satisfying but color-intent missing — measured by compose-recall and called out as a hosted-embedding trigger.
Every composed piece must itself be black AND winter-gated; the hard-constraint guard re-verifies each id.

Tightest case: candidates after the union extractor are {t2,t5,b2,b4}. The pipeline only CONTRACTS to a grounded look whose every piece satisfies the constraints; picking the exact named pair is a RANKING quality signal, and the offline hash embedding demonstrably prefers the shorter-text black tank (t5) over the turtleneck (t2) — logged as a finding, not a golden failure.
全黑(black) + 冬(winter) → same candidate set as hard-en-01 through the CJK lane.
Catalog deliberately has NO bags → zero candidates after the hard filter is a valid, lossless state (NO_MATCHES), not an error.

cases.query: 一个精致的黑色手提包
cases.note: 手提包→bags through the CJK lane; same empty-candidate outcome.

cases.query: give me something minimalist for a city day
cases.note: No extractable hard constraint; 'minimalist' rides the soft lane into the embedded query text and must recall the minimalist-tagged pieces.

cases.query: 极简 minimalist 风格的一天穿搭
cases.note: 极简 expands via textrep (minimalist→极简); the Latin token keeps the offline hash overlap deterministic. Pure-CJK style recall is an open question (see EVALUATION.md).
Every winter piece is weather-compatible with {cold,cool}; the weather guard should pass vacuously-then-positively.
冬天→winter; same positive path as weather-en-01.

Deliberate trait bug in the catalog: s3 is a summer-season CANDIDATE but tagged cool/mild, not {warm,hot}. The deterministic weather guard must reject the composed look even though every piece satisfies the hard constraints — constraintSatisfied=true while validation=false proves the two signals are distinct.

cases.query: a crew neck tee with jeans
cases.note: A duplicate of t1's vector record is seeded under ghost-t1 before the run. It must never surface in hits or the composed look (no metadata to pass the filter, no catalog entry to survive compose).
Ghost variant through the CJK lane.

UNCONSTRAINED query ('crew'/'neck' are not vocabulary, so hard=={}): the pipeline STILL removes ghost-t1 in the search pre-filter, because query.hard is always an object and filterByConstraints runs the getItem liveness check even for an empty filter. Layer-1 (search liveness) therefore always wins inside recommend; the compose drop (layer-2) is defense-in-depth and is exercised directly in the eval unit tests via semanticSearch(constraints:null). The low scores also surface the offline hash embedding's weak discrimination for one-shot style queries — a hosted-embedding trigger.
